detail:
Full summary: Applied all 11 surviving findings from the targeted pre-merge review of creation-time provisional (0 refuted): supersedes+provisional rejected, record status gated to full_surface, provisionals join conflict detection, what_changed mislabel fixed, stale comments/spec claim corrected, tests hardened. 1434 green.
Decisions: Chose to reject status:provisional + supersedes at creation (INVALID_INPUT) over deferring supersession to promote() — deferral needs pending_supersedes plumbing across both stores and override(), a mechanism change beyond this release; rejection is the conservative default and the error tells users the two valid paths; Chose to gate provisional minting via twining_record behind tools.full_surface (per-decision error, decision NOT recorded) over co-registering promote/override on the default surface — co-promotion is exactly what spec §6.1's field-data test defers; the default surface must not create provisionals it cannot drain; Chose to include provisional entries in decide()'s conflict scan — pending provisionals are live constraints (assemble/verify/why already treat them as such); excluding them let contradictory decisions ratify with no overlap finding ever posted; Chose to exclude ids already in new_decisions from what_changed's reconsidered_decisions — a created-in-window provisional is a new provisional, not a reconsideration
Findings: The targeted 6-agent review (386K tokens) surfaced 2 real design gaps and 9 hardening items in a change the full suite had already passed green — the assumes-active hunter dimension was the payoff; right-sized reviews of lifecycle-adjacent changes are worth their cost; warning: decide()'s duplicate-summary auto-demote no longer exists (removed in 09b1c92) — stale comments claiming it were corrected in this pass; do not reintroduce provisional-on-conflict demotion, status comes only from input
